definition: Test bias is unfairness in a test or in particular test items that can make results differ for groups for reasons other than the ability or skill being measured. Analyses such as differential item functioning can help flag possible bias, but such findings are only a warning sign and need further review to judge whether the items are truly inappropriate or unfair.
